notes: Read all 110 numbered source lines before editing. Imports L1-10: react useEffect/useMemo (L1) kept (useMemo also drives the location resolver) plus useCallback/ReactNode added for the i18n shim + inline PageContainer; react-router-dom Link/useLocation/useNavigate (L2) -> useLocation becomes useResolvedLocation(pathname?,search?) feature-detecting window.location, and Link/useNavigate become the optional onNavigate(path) prop fired from Pressables; react-i18next useTranslation (L3) -> inlined useNativeTranslation(); lucide-react ArrowLeft/Compass/Home/Search (L4) -> SemanticIcon back/navigation/home/search; @/components/layout PageContainer (L6) -> inline native PageContainer (title-only subset, the only props the source passes); @/components/ui Button+GlassPanel (L7) -> inline native ActionButton (variant+icon+label, since shared AppButton has no icon slot) + shared native GlassPanel; @/hooks/usePageTitle (L8) -> native-safe usePageTitle; @/lib/routeRegistry ROUTE_REGISTRY (L9) + @/lib/closestRoute closestRoutes (L10) -> inlined verbatim (pure DOM-free data table + Levenshtein ranker; their own native modules port on their own turns, so inlined here per the CommandsPage inline-dependency precedent).

Doc comment L12-23 -> ported into the native header doc (catch-all 404, console.warn 404-storm logging, Levenshtein suggestions, back/dashboard/command-palette escape hatches) alongside the native remap table.

Component shell L24-27: default export NotFoundPage gains an optional props object {pathname,search,onNavigate,onGoBack,onOpenCommandPalette} (the native-safe replacements for useLocation/useNavigate/window). t = useNativeTranslation() (L25); location = useResolvedLocation(pathname,search) replaces useLocation() (L26); navigate (L27) is represented by onNavigate.

usePageTitle L29 preserved verbatim: usePageTitle(t('notFound.title','Page not found')) — native shim feature-detects document.title (present on react-native-web), writes '{title} — TeslaSync', restores on unmount.

useEffect 404 log L31-33 ported verbatim: console.warn('[404]', location.pathname + location.search) with deps [location.pathname, location.search]. console.warn exists in React Native, so the dev 404-storm logging behaviour is identical.

suggestions useMemo L35-38 ported verbatim: closestRoutes(location.pathname, ROUTE_REGISTRY, 5) with dep [location.pathname]. The inlined closestRoutes/normalize/levenshtein reproduce the web ranker exactly (hidden routes skipped, distance<=6 kept, min(pathDist,labelDist), sort by distance then path.localeCompare, slice to limit). levenshtein is ported without param reassignment (local short/long) to stay lint-clean while preserving the two-row O(m*n) algorithm and results; normalize renamed normalizeRoute to avoid any global shadow. ROUTE_REGISTRY is the full 113-entry table copied verbatim incl. hidden flags so suggestions match the web output.

openCommandPalette L40-42 -> native openCommandPalette: prefers the onOpenCommandPalette prop, else feature-detects globalThis.dispatchEvent + Event and dispatches the SAME 'toggle-command-palette' event (event name preserved; works on react-native-web, no-op on bare native).

Render L44-108: PageContainer title L45 preserved (t('notFound.title','Page not found')). GlassPanel L46 (mx-auto max-w-2xl px-6 py-12 text-center) -> native GlassPanel styles.panel (alignSelf center, maxWidth 672, width 100%, paddingHorizontal 24, paddingVertical 48, alignItems center). Compass L47-50 (mx-auto mb-4 h-12 w-12 text-muted, aria-hidden) -> decorative SemanticIcon name='navigation' size='lg' in a marginBottom:16 wrap. h2 L51-53 (text-2xl font-semibold text-primary) -> AppText variant='title' weight='semibold' accessibilityRole='header' textAlign center, text t('notFound.heading',"We couldn't find that page"). p L54-59 (mt-2 break-all text-secondary) -> AppText tone='secondary' marginTop:8 textAlign center; body i18n call t('notFound.body',{defaultValue:"{{path}} doesn't match any route.", path: location.pathname}) preserved verbatim and the shim interpolates {{path}} (skipping the defaultValue key).

Suggestions block L61-82 ported: rendered only when suggestions.length>0; 'Did you mean:' label L63-65 -> AppText muted caption (t('notFound.didYouMean','Did you mean:')); ul L66-80 (flex-col items-center gap-2) -> a centred gap:spacing.sm column; each Link L69-77 (to=s.path, text-cyan-300, label + path span ml-2) -> a Pressable accessibilityRole='link' key=s.path onPress=onNavigate?.(s.path) row with the label AppText tinted CYAN_300 (#67e8f9 = text-cyan-300) and the path AppText muted caption (the ml-2 spacing is the row gap). Suggestion label uses t(s.i18nKey, s.label) verbatim.

Actions L84-106 ported: row (flex-wrap items-center justify-center gap-3, marginTop 32) of three ActionButtons — Go back (ghost, back icon, onPress=goBack) L85-91; Go to dashboard (primary, home icon, onPress=onNavigate?.('/')) L92-98; Open command palette (ghost, search icon, onPress=openCommandPalette) L99-105. Every icon is decorative to match the web aria-hidden icons; every button label keeps its English i18n fallback.
goBack replaces window.history.back() L87: prefers the onGoBack prop, else feature-detects globalThis.history.back() (works on react-native-web, no-op on bare native).
Closing L107-110 preserved (GlassPanel close, PageContainer close, function close, file end).

Browser-only behaviour made native-safe (contract rules 4,5,7): useLocation -> props + window.location feature-detection; useNavigate/Link -> onNavigate prop; window.history.back -> onGoBack prop + history feature-detection; window.dispatchEvent('toggle-command-palette') -> onOpenCommandPalette prop + dispatchEvent feature-detection. No DOM elements (div/h2/p/ul/li/span), no react-router-dom, no react-i18next, no lucide-react, no Recharts/Leaflet, and no @/ web UI modules in the native output — only react-native primitives (View/ScrollView/Pressable/StyleSheet) and the shared native SemanticIcon/AppText/GlassPanel + theme tokens. The page carries no physical units, so no unit conversion was introduced. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) clean; npm run lint -- --quiet clean; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles green.
